comparison.objective: Stow a screwdriver while preventing a two-drawer tool chest from tipping; the candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Drawer sequencing, chest stability management, and object placement versus tool seating and countertorque on a screw/jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Screwdriver rests in the right drawer without chest tip or drag; candidate retains the target opening through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Tip-over avoidance during drawer use is unrelated to adjustable-stop calibration and locking.
